columns.rationale: Landed as VARCHAR with null_rate 0.0 across 45228 rows and distinct_count 2330; sample_values such as "489434" and "489443" are digit-only but the column is retained as text because invoice identifiers are not arithmetic and the profile shows no evidence that every value is numeric.

null_rate 0.0 and distinct_count 3141, with sample_values mixing digit-only codes ("10002", "10080") and alphanumeric codes ("10002R", "10123C", "10123G"), so the samples disagree on numeric shape and the column stays VARCHAR; renamed to snake_case.

null_count 228 of 45228 rows (null_rate 0.005041) and distinct_count 3045, so nulls are retained rather than imputed; sample_values carry leading and trailing spaces (" ANIMAL STICKERS", " BROWN  PIRATE TREASURE CHEST "), which a consumer should expect when matching on this text.

Landed as DECIMAL(38,9) with null_rate 0.0, min -1395.0 and max 5184.0, and every sample_value is integral (-1395.0, -1043.0, -504.0), so the cast to INTEGER is supported; negative values are retained because they represent returns or adjustments.

Derived as quantity < 0 from the same column, whose min is -1395.0 and whose sample_values include ten negative quantities; the flag lets consumers separate return and adjustment lines from sales lines without re-deriving the sign test.

Landed as VARCHAR with null_rate 0.0 and distinct_count 2004; every sample_value is ISO-shaped to the minute ("2009-12-01 07:45:00" through "2009-12-01 09:50:00"), which supports the cast to TIMESTAMP, and the name is renamed to snake_case.

Landed as DECIMAL(38,9) with null_rate 0.0, min 0.0 and max 1998.49, and all sample_values carry at most two decimal places (0.04, 0.06, 0.18), so DECIMAL(10,2) holds every observed value; zero-price lines are retained since min is 0.0.

Landed as DECIMAL(38,9) with 13468 nulls (null_rate 0.29778) and distinct_count 1045; min 12346.0 and max 18287.0 with integral sample_values (12346.0, 12349.0, 12358.0) support the INTEGER cast, and the roughly 30 percent of rows without a customer are retained as null.

null_rate 0.0 with a low distinct_count of 24 and sample_values such as "Australia", "Channel Islands", "EIRE" and "Germany"; kept as free text because the profile shows display names rather than a coded standard.

Profile marks this column is_airbyte_metadata true; its two distinct_values ("2026-07-27T10:24:46" and "2026-07-27T10:24:47") record load timing, not business timing.
Profile marks this column is_airbyte_metadata true and its single distinct value is "{}", carrying no business content.

decisions.rationale: dataset.duplicate_row_rate is 0.011188 over dataset.row_count 45228, roughly 506 rows that repeat another row exactly; identical business tuples are collapsed to one row on the eight retained business columns since the bronze capture carries no attribute that distinguishes them.

invoice has distinct_count 2330 and stock_code 3141, both with null_rate 0.0, and an invoice line is conventionally one product per invoice, so this is the smallest defensible grain after exact duplicates are collapsed; a reviewer must measure it in the warehouse because the profile cannot prove a product appears only once per invoice.
_airbyte_raw_id, _airbyte_extracted_at and _airbyte_meta each carry is_airbyte_metadata true and describe the load rather than the sale, so none of them reach silver.

customer_id has null_count 13468 of 45228 rows (null_rate 0.29778); these are guest or unattributed transactions that are still valid sales, so nulls are retained rather than dropped or imputed and the column is not part of the grain.
description has null_count 228 (null_rate 0.005041); the sparse nulls are retained because a missing product description does not invalidate the sale line.

quantity, price and customer_id all land as DECIMAL(38,9); integral samples and min/max of -1395.0/5184.0 justify quantity as INTEGER, integral samples and 12346.0/18287.0 justify customer_id as INTEGER, and two-decimal samples with max 1998.49 justify price as DECIMAL(10,2).

invoicedate lands as VARCHAR but every sample_value matches the ISO form "2009-12-01 07:45:00" with null_rate 0.0, so the strict cast to TIMESTAMP is safe and any non-conforming value should surface as a build failure for review.

stockcode sample_values include alphanumeric codes such as "10002R" and "10123C" alongside digit-only codes, and invoice identifiers are not arithmetic, so both stay VARCHAR instead of being cast to a numeric type.
quantity min is -1395.0 and ten sample_values are negative, so an is_return boolean is derived from quantity < 0 to make return and adjustment lines explicit without changing the quantity values.

purpose: silver_online_retail_ii is the cleaned, one-row-per-invoice-line view of the bronze online_retail_ii capture (45228 rows): eight business columns with consistent snake_case names and warehouse-native types, plus a derived is_return flag, feeding downstream sales, product and customer aggregates.
usage: Read one row as one product line on one invoice, keyed by invoice and stock_code after exact duplicates are collapsed. Quantity is a signed INTEGER and price a DECIMAL(10,2), so revenue is quantity * price; filter on is_return = false (or quantity > 0) deliberately when you want gross sales only, because returns and adjustments are retained in place. customer_id is null for roughly 30 percent of rows, so join it as an outer join or filter explicitly when building customer-level metrics.
limitations: The declared grain of invoice plus stock_code is inferred from distinct_count 2330 and 3141 and is not proven by the profile; a product repeated on one invoice at two prices would violate it and must be measured before approval. Exact duplicate collapse removes the roughly 1.1188 percent of rows that repeat another row exactly, which is irreversible from silver, and it cannot distinguish a genuine repeated line from a capture artifact. customer_id is unresolvable for 13468 rows (null_rate 0.29778) and description for 228 rows (null_rate 0.005041); no imputation was applied. Description values retain leading and trailing whitespace as landed, country is free text across 24 distinct display names with no standard code applied, and zero-price lines (min 0.0) and negative quantities (min -1395.0) are preserved rather than filtered.
